rows.en:
(I'm supposed to meet Ranka-chan
at the school gate, but...)

\p-chan!
Merry Christmas!
Merry Christmas, Ranka-chan.

I can't wait for this year's Christmas party!
Let's all have even more fun than last year!
Huh? Okay, hang on a sec~!
That was fun again this year~
It turned out to be a fun Christmas~
Yeah, here's to next year too!

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Ranka-chan
surprised me a little~)

(I'm going to the Academy Christmas party
with Sheryl, but...)

Hi~, \p!
Merry Christmas!

Oh, Sheryl...!
Wait, what's with that outfit?!

Oh, this...
I got asked to sing a little
at the party, you see.
rows.notes: Both versions. Passive in the Japanese too (tanomarechatte); the asker is never named.

rows.en: Oh, I see.

So I got a costume ready
to get in the mood.
Got it. Good luck!

Hee hee.
I'm Sheryl. I'll just do what I always do.
Spoken like a true star!

That Christmas party was fun!
And your song was great too, Sheryl.

Hee hee, thank you.
I hope we can spend it like this next year, too.

Though a Christmas for just the two of us...
might not be bad either.

Hee hee, I'm joking.
Well, I'm counting on you next year too.
(That was one amazing Christmas!)

(I'm going to the Academy Christmas party
with Sheryl-san, but...)

Hi~, \p-chan!
Merry Christmas!

Oh, Sheryl-san...!
Wait, what's with that outfit?!
Oh, is that so?
Ahaha, good luck out there!
Spoken like a true star!

That Christmas party was so fun!
And your song was great too, Sheryl-san!
I really hope so too.
rows.notes: Answers Sheryl's 'I hope we can spend it like this next year too'.

rows.en:
Well, shall we head home?
I'm counting on you next year too.
(That was one glamorous Christmas!)

(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Klan-senpai, but...)

Merry Christmas to you,
\p!

You bet!
We're gonna have even more fun than last year!

Though I'm sure a party with just
the two of us would've been fun, too.

Now, let's hurry to the party,
\p!
Wow, that was fun again this year~

Who'd have thought Michel would dress up
as a girl together with Alto...

Alto's one thing, but it kind of suited Michel
too, which was a little creepy.
But really, it was a fun Christmas.

Mm, it was.
I'm glad I came to the party
with you today.

W-well, I'm heading home now.
I'm counting on you next year too,
\p.
The same goes for me, Klan-senpai.
rows.notes: Both versions. Kochira koso yoroshiku onegai shimasu.

rows.en:
(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas.
I hope I can have fun with Klan-senpai
and the others next year too.)

(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Klan-senpai, but...)
rows.notes: Female version; same English as c22779.

rows.en:
(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas.
I hope I can have fun with Klan-senpai
and the others next year too.)

(I wanted to give Kagura-kun the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

So this is where you were,
\p.
Kagura-kun?! What are you doing here?

I heard you'd been looking for me all day,
so I came looking for you too.

Oh, so that's why...
Here, Kagura-kun. It's late, but
this is your Valentine's chocolate.
rows.notes: Line break moved to fit; same meaning.

rows.en:
Thanks, \p.
I'll be sure to enjoy it later.

I'll pay you back properly on White Day,
so look forward to it.
Okay, I'll look forward to it.

(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Kagura-kun the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)

(I wanted to give Gary-sensei the chocolate,
but the timing never worked out...)

Hm, \p?
What's wrong? Why so down?
Oh, Gary-sensei, you're still here?

Yeah, it's Valentine's Day, after all.
If I don't stick around school as long as I can,
the girls can't give me their feelings.

Hahaha, don't make that face, I'm joking.
All I got was a few obligation chocolates...
Kids these days don't know gratitude!
Um, Sensei, if you'd like, this is for you...
Huh? Oh, for me?
Yes. You always look out for me, after all.

I see. Then I'll gratefully accept it.
I'll be sure to thank you properly on White Day.
Oh, you don't have to worry about that...
Well, if I still remember by then, that is!

(Is that Sensei's way of covering up
his embarrassment...?)

(I bought chocolate for Luis-san, who always
looks out for me, but now that it's time
to give it to him, I'm nervous...)

(I wanted to give Luis-san the chocolate,
but he pops up and vanishes so randomly
that I couldn't find him...)

What's with the sentimental face in a place
like this, fresh girl?
rows.notes: Luis's English loanwords kept (furesshu gaaru, senchimentaru).

rows.en:
Luis-san?!
I was just looking for you!
rows.notes: The Japanese repeats his name; English uses 'you'.

rows.en: Hm? You've got business with me?

It's Valentine's Day, so I wanted to give you
some chocolate... Here, Luis-san.
This Valentine's chocolate is for you!

Come to think of it, today's Valentine's Day.
To think I'd forget even that...
I must be going senile...

Thanks, fresh girl!
I'll be sure to savor it later.

And on White Day, I'll give you something back
with my whole soul in it, so look forward to it!
Okay, I'll be looking forward to it!

(It was a bit late, but I'm glad I managed
to give Luis-san the chocolate. I wonder
what he'll give me back on White Day?)
